title: Created Privacy Policy For Document Abantecart.com
body:
I noticed that the website has no privacy policy.

This is really important as it is supposed to ....

 Give current and potential subscribers /endusers of your software or app,  a clear idea of what kind of information, why the website or app  collects such information and  how such collected information is used or shared ( where necessary) by Abantecart.com. ... in the course of downloading and use of the application by an end user.

In other words, a privacy policy is a statement or a legal document 
 that discloses some or all of the ways a business / website gathers, uses, discloses, and manages a customer or client's data. It fulfills a legal requirement to protect a customer or client's privacy.

Every serious business / ecommerce / service provider website currently has one. In my vast experience, I strongly believe that Abantecart.com needs one as well.

I would like to put my skills as an  experienced advertising  and sales copywriter to good use for Abantecart.com ... with subsequent content creation  and other copy writing tasks later on, to create an all-encompassing  Privacy Policy for Abantecart.com.

Please let me know asap If I can go ahead and post it here...  or as a pull request.
Thanks.
